questions.question_bn: 8 mol primary alcohol RCH₂OH fully oxidise toRCOOH। total electron loss কত mol?

questions.question_bn: Acyclic hydrocarbon C9H18 with oneC=C, no ring। sigma-bond count কত?

questions.question_bn: Electron momentum 8p₀। wavelength ratio λ/λ₀ কত?

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=441×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?

questions.question_bn: Ozone decomposition 2O₃→3O₂। 22 mol ozone fully decomposes। total gas mole increase কত?

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 20mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 5mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?

questions.question_bn: Acyclic mono alkyne C3H4। total sigma-bond count কত?
